map.输入初级与次级线圈电阻值，对照标准范围判断点火线圈是否正常，并估算匝数比。: Enter primary and secondary winding resistance and compare with the standard range to judge whether the ignition coil is sound, and estimate the turns ratio.
map.分组点火（废火花，同 COP 范围）: Paired wasted-spark coils (same range as COP)
map.初级对地是否短路: Is the primary shorted to ground?
map.次级电阻明显偏低（< 4 kΩ）多为匝间短路，表现为高速失火、加速无力；次级开路: Clearly low secondary resistance (< 4 kΩ) usually means shorted turns, showing up as high-speed misfire and poor acceleration; an open secondary or abruptly high resistance usually means a burnt winding, leaving that cylinder dead with a misfire code (P030x).
map.铜绕组电阻随温度上升而增大，约 +0.393%/℃。热车测量值偏高属正常，比较时: Copper winding resistance rises with temperature at about +0.393%/°C. A high reading on a hot engine is normal, so convert to 20 °C before comparing with the standard range.
map.💡 电阻合格不代表点火能量正常：还需结合火花塞间隙、次级高压波形与失火计数综合判: 💡 Passing resistance does not prove healthy ignition energy: judge together with spark plug gap, secondary waveform and misfire counts. Disconnect power and unplug the connector before measuring.
map.发动机报单缸失火码（P030x）时，测量点火线圈初级与次级电阻，快速判断绕组短路: When the engine logs a single-cylinder misfire code (P030x), measure primary and secondary resistance to decide quickly between a shorted and an open winding.
map.更换线圈前与同型正常线圈对比阻值，避免凭经验误换件。: Compare readings against a known-good coil of the same type before replacing parts, instead of swapping on guesswork.
map.热车测量读数偏高时，折算至 20 ℃ 再与标准范围比较，减少误判。: When a hot engine reads high, convert to 20 °C first and then compare against the standard range to avoid misjudgment.
map.独立点火（COP）线圈电阻判定: Resistance judgement for a coil-on-plug (COP) unit
map.COP 线圈实测初级 0.8 Ω、次级 8 kΩ，测量温度 25 ℃：温度折算系: A COP coil measuring 0.8 Ω primary and 8 kΩ secondary at 25 °C: the temperature factor is 1+0.00393×(25−20)=1.020, giving 0.78 Ω and 7.85 kΩ corrected, both within the standard range (primary 0.3~1.5 Ω, secondary 5~15 kΩ), so the winding itself is sound. Taking the square root of the resistance ratio gives an equivalent turns ratio near 100:1, so a primary back-EMF of about 350 V puts secondary output near 35 kV. If misfire persists, turn to spark plug gap, the ignition module and harness connectors.
map.电阻正常为什么还会失火？: Why does it still misfire with normal resistance?
map.电阻只能反映绕组通断与阻值大小，无法反映绝缘老化或轻微匝间短路。需结合火花塞间隙: Resistance only reveals continuity and magnitude; it cannot show insulation aging or mild inter-turn shorts. Judge together with plug gap, secondary waveform and misfire counts, using an ignition scope if necessary.
map.为什么要断电后再测量？: Why must the power be off before measuring?
map.带电测量会引入并联电路电阻，读数失真；且点火瞬间初级会产生数百伏反电动势，带电操: Measuring live introduces parallel circuit resistance and distorts the reading; moreover the primary generates hundreds of volts of back-EMF at the spark instant, risking shock and damage to the meter. Turn the ignition off and unplug the connector before measuring.
map.须断电并拔下插头测量，热车读数应折算至 20 ℃ 再对照标准值: Measure with power off and the plug removed; convert hot readings to 20 °C before comparing with standard values
